name: financial-intelligence-system
tagline: A full-stack financial intelligence platform with a Vue web companion
description: financial-intelligence-system is a Java-backed financial intelligence platform paired with a Vue.js web companion. The Java backend handles the heavy lifting of data analysis and market intelligence, while the Vue front end presents results in a usable dashboard. It is a complete full-stack package rather than a single library, giving you both the analytical engine and the interface to browse it. A solid reference for anyone building data-heavy finance tooling with a JVM backend.
highlights: Java backend for financial data analysis and market intelligence
Vue.js web companion for a clean, browsable interface
Complete full-stack architecture, not a single-library fragment
Useful reference for JVM-based finance tooling
curatorNote: Finance dashboards are everywhere, but a clean Java + Vue full-stack intelligence system is a refreshingly complete blueprint. Good study material and a potential starting point for your own data-heavy product.
